4279-5933-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5933-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2790-3851-4836.easyPrerequisites:
Angel of Destiny doesn't have summoning sickness.
Your life total is equal to or greater than 55 minus 4 for each opponent you have.
Blade of Selves is attached to Angel of Destiny.
2790-3851-4836.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
2790-3851-4836.description:
Declare Angel of Destiny as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Angel of Destiny attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with Angel of Destiny, causing each Angel of Destiny to trigger, causing you to gain 4 life for each Angel of Destiny and causing each opponent to gain 4 life.
Move to your end step. The Angel of Destiny tokens won't be exiled due to The Master.
At the beginning of your end step, each Angel of Destiny triggers, causing each opponent they dealt combat damage to to lose the game.

719-2099-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-2099-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2443-2841-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-864-2438-3125-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2438-3125-5631.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-2738-4314-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-4365-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3263-5147-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5147-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Goblin Bombardment.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

392-2034-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat
392-2034-5220-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

2060-4518-6930-7729.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Spider-Man India and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man India trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

4907-5231-6709-6989.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn

1636-4050-6786-7028-7148.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

2511-4053-7134--145.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2829-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1482-1537.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Zealous Conscripts.
When Zealous Conscripts enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger

24-3417-6899.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-3417-6899.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

5641-5662-6258.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Thunderous Velocipede.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 3.

1251-1563-2457-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3240-5686-6462-6560.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

542-2104-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
542-2104-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
542-2104-6333.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

413-560-1940-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-560-1940-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Liliana triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Blasting Station trigger, sacrificing the Soldier token instead.
Repeat.

2438-2525-2947.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

236-1283-4019.notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
236-1283-4019.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {3}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

1379-1565-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mintstrosity, adding {C}{C}.
When Mintstrosity dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Mintstrosity trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Mintstrosity from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

198-2905-4499.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
198-2905-4499.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Pestermite.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2067-2280-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than nineteen.
2067-2280-3858.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

1447-2034-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Human" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1447-2034-4192.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

721-1522-2724.description:
Activate Disappear by paying {U}, returning itself and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Cast Disappear by paying {2}{U}{U} targeting Wormfang Manta.
Repeat.

313-914-2292.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
313-914-2292.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, scrying 1.
Activate five of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
